title: Version-Aware Auth Engine, EventLike Trait & Streaming Auth Cache (v0.2.0)
public_safety_audit_summary: Establishes the version-aware PDU authorization engine (src/auth/mod.rs), generic EventId/EventContent/EventLike/RawEvent zero-copy traits, streaming state reconstruction (compute_state_at_streaming), LocalAuthCache hoisting, and zero-copy SortContext. Cross-references two key findings in rezzy_docs_public_safety_audit.md: (1) Row #2 (architecture.md, Critical OOM / Starvation) where pre-fetching full conflicted graphs in the synchronous I/O sandwich exposes the homeserver to OOM or executor starvation on catastrophic forks, and (2) Row #4 (design_notes.md, High Heuristic Bypass) where assuming 10-50 conflicted events fit in L1 cache underestimates 10^4+ event adversarial partitions and custom EventContent implementations risk subtle spec drift.
